title: Task dependencies
statement: The system shall let a task declare the tasks it depends on in a depends_on list of task ids, rejecting unknown ids, self-references and dependency cycles.
rationale: Starting a task must be blocked until the work it builds on is done, which needs dependencies recorded on tasks.

acceptance_criteria.text: depends_on accepts ids of existing tasks and rejects an unknown id with a field error
A self-reference or any dependency cycle is rejected with a field error naming the cycle
Deleting a task that another task depends on is refused unless forced, as for other references
